action.description: The exact action payload covered by actionDigest; the kernel digests its canonical form.

command.description: The command envelope held until consent (persist-first law D3): the kernel stores it and hands it back on consume, so execution runs exactly what consent covered.

requestedBy.description: Canonical actor behind the request (the verified human subject, or the workload when unverified): the consent-authority rules evaluate against it.

ruleId.description: The policy rule that made this consent necessary (name or locator): consent must be attributable to a rule a human can point at.

notRequester.description: Rule flag: the requester side (the recording workload's team) may not give sole consent.

workId.description: Work the approval belongs to, when one exists.
